title: No one knows what colours Jupiter
description:
Light clouds are usually higher than dark ones. The cause of Jupiter’s colours is still open.
NASA picture: JPL, PIA24972, JunoCam, colour boosted by citizen scientist Brian Swift.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Matt Brealey and Seán Doran: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-22-swirls-and-colors-on-jupiter-from-juno/. To use it, please ask the owners.
